prompt:
You are a equity research analyst. Using only the information below and general knowledge predating 2026-03-19, give a 20-trading-day directional recommendation for the stock.
Valid answers (choose exactly one): BUY, HOLD, SELL.
Company information (as of 2026-03-19):
Price action as of 2026-03-19: 1w -1.5%, 1m -6.1%, 3m +16.2%. Last close 114.20. 21d annualized realized volatility 23%. Position in trailing 63-day range: 61% (0%=low, 100%=high).
Reason briefly in 1-3 sentences. Then, on a separate final line, output exactly:
DECISION: <one label>
raw_response:
The stock shows medium-term momentum (+16% over 3m) but has experienced a clear short-term pullback (-6% over 1m and -1.5% over 1w). At 61% of the 63-day range with only moderate realized volatility, price sits in neutral territory without oversold/overbought signals or breakout confirmation. For a ~20-trading-day horizon this produces mixed technicals without a high-conviction directional edge.
DECISION: HOLD
